Six (6) months experience transporting patients in a hospital, skilled nursing facility, or as an EMT.

The Patient Transport Technician plays a critical role in supporting patient care operations and hospital throughput by providing safe, timely, and efficient transportation of patients throughout the facility. This position is responsible for transporting conscious, semi-conscious, and unconscious patients to and from nursing units, treatment areas, diagnostic imaging departments, procedural areas, and other care locations using wheelchairs, gurneys, and hospital beds.

Key responsibilities include assisting with patient lifting, turning, repositioning, and transfers for patients requiring moderate to total assistance while adhering to Safe Patient Handling standards and utilizing approved patient lift equipment. The technician is responsible for ensuring patients are transported safely, comfortably, and in accordance with established patient care and safety protocols.In addition to patient transportation, this role supports hospital operations by transporting medical equipment, oxygen cylinders, medical records, Video Swallow Chairs, imaging-related materials, and other items requested by nursing and ancillary departments. The position also manages the movement of empty beds, mattresses, and related equipment between nursing units and designated storage locations to support patient placement and bed availability needs.

This position requires close collaboration with the Transport Call Center, Nursing units, Imaging departments, and other hospital teams to prioritize transport assignments, improve workflow efficiency, and support patient throughput goals. The Patient Transport Technician is also responsible for identifying equipment issues and submitting service requests to Information Technology, Biomedical Engineering, and Facilities departments as needed to maintain operational readiness.
The primary location for these positions will be La Jolla but there will be a requirement to float to our East Campus and Hillcrest as needed.
Depending on experience of the selected candidate, this position will be hired at the Tech I or Tech II level.
Must be able to stand and walk for long periods of time.
Must be able to lift over 50 pounds and able to push/ pull a gurney or bed with patients weighing up to 300 pounds.
Must be able to independently move an empty bed.
Must be willing to work overtime weekends as needed to meet the business needs of the department.
